testSmells.title: Improper Organization
testSmells.message:
It does not have a Proper Organization.

Tests should have the following structure:

- Arrange: This is where you initialize objects and set the value of the data to be passed to the function under test.

- Act: The act section invokes the function under test.

- Assert: This is where you verify that the action of the function under test behaves as expected.

So asserts should be together at the end of the test.

test37BoulderDuringGuardedRunUndoesMovementsToItsStart

	crawler := self crawlerFacingUpAt: 1@2 withBoulderAt: 1@4.
	
	self 
		assertThat: crawler
		failsProcessing: '(aa)'
		with: SurveyCrawler boulderAheadErrorDescription
		endingAt: 1@2
		facing: #Up

assertThat: aCrawler failsProcessing: aSequenceOfCommands with: anErrorDescription endingAt: aPosition facing: aFacingName

	self 
		should: [ aCrawler process: aSequenceOfCommands ]
		raise: Error - MessageNotUnderstood 
		withExceptionDo: [ :anError |
			self assert: anError messageText equals: anErrorDescription.
			self assert: (aCrawler isAt: aPosition facing: aFacingName) ]
